[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Course overview and prerequisites (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.
Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L07 UGC 2 (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
Use the uploaded character sheet for the [woman] and the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT]. Keep her face, hair and outfit exactly the same as the character sheet. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing. Vertical video shot from her own phone resting on the desk in front of her: the camera itself is the phone, so we see her and the [PRODUCT] from a low front angle. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen facing us. She uses the [PRODUCT] for a moment, then looks up straight into the lens and talks, casual and natural. Natural window light, a real lived-in room, not a studio, not a polished ad. ONLY she speaks, one voice only, natural Hindi lip-sync, casual friendly tone. She says: "[your second line in Hindi]" real skin, no filter, clearly adult, modest, natural hands with five fingers, no text on screen, no watermark. Clean natural audio only — NO background music.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L07 UGC 1 (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
Use the uploaded character sheet for the [woman] and the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT]. Keep her face, hair and outfit exactly the same as the character sheet. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing. Selfie-style vertical video: the camera itself is her phone, held at arm's length, so we see her from the chest up looking straight into the lens. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen. She sits at a desk in a normal home room, holding the [PRODUCT] up near her chest to show it, casual and friendly. Handheld look with slight natural shake, natural window light, a real lived-in room, not a studio, not a polished ad. ONLY she speaks, one voice only, natural Hindi lip-sync, casual friendly tone. She says: "[your hook line in Hindi]" real skin, no filter, clearly adult, modest, natural hands with five fingers, no text on screen, no watermark. Clean natural audio only — NO background music.
